report: Veda Spaces P0 foundation architecture validation

method.coverage_rule: A dimension is covered only if its registry reference resolves to a numbered section and that section explicitly cites the requirement ID.
method.trace_annotations: Section-level 'Traces:' lines were generated from the reviewed registry mapping to make each mapping visible in the covered section. 'natively_cited_before_trace_annotation' shows how many were already cited in prose. Semantic adequacy of each mapping is for the independent reviewer.
method.tooling: Validation scripts were run in the authoring session and are intentionally not committed (no code in this freeze).

deferred_requirements.title: Bulk exports are audited (who, when, filter, row count).
Configurable audit retention with verified archival.
Personal-data anonymization of audit payloads only via an audited procedure.
Users list and revoke their sessions; admins revoke any user's sessions.
The daily chain head is anchored in S3 Object Lock.
Role and permission assignments can be time-bound.
An effective-permissions view explains every permission's source.
Leads can be exported to CSV (permission-gated, audited).
Quoted amount is recorded in minor units.
Call and WhatsApp buttons prompt a prefilled activity quick-log.
Initial JS below 200 KB gzipped and LCP below 2.5 s on 4G.

assumptions.text: The staff user base during P0 is small (tens of people), within a single-instance deployment's capacity
P0 write concurrency is within SQLite's single-writer capacity
Table growth classes in 03 §11 are qualitative guesses
Security-event volumes are unknown. Alert, lockout and rate-limit thresholds are initial configuration values.
The website's existing "Property Type" field is not sent to the public API, because ADR-005 enumerates the public fields. Staff capture property type during enrichment.
Retention defaults: audit 2 y online / 8 y total · security events 1 y / 2 y · closed-lead anonymization 3 y
NFR-001 load-test fixture sizes (100k leads, 1M audit rows) are test fixtures, not forecasts
SES production access will be granted. Until then, the capture adapter means no outbound email outside production.
A host with at least 2 GB RAM is sufficient for Argon2id parameters
The website will publish a versioned privacy notice whose version id is sent as `consent.policy_version`
The AWS region is ap-south-1 (Mumbai). ADR-008 fixes AWS but not the region.

audit_contract.exception: Rows are immutable: never updated or soft-deleted. `updated_on = created_on`, `updated_by = created_by`, `version = 1`, `is_deleted = false` for life.
Hard-deleted by the retention job after archival
Hard-deleted by purge after expiry, never soft-deleted
DONE rows hard-deleted after the configured retention
Hard-deleted after the configured retention once read
Never soft-deleted. The lifecycle uses `revoked_on`, `used_on` and `invalidated_on`.
Cannot be soft-deleted, disabled or given credentials

owner_inputs_go_live_preconditions.input: Approved RPO, RTO and API availability target
